unresolved_integration_requirements: Classify every recognized event by actual consumer and resulting state.
Retain absolute HP and its provenance before percentage conversion.
Align normal requests and mid-turn switches without inventing upkeep.
Do not treat unmodified default fields as evidence of absence.
Use item events, not monState.itemUsed, for consumption evidence.
Use perish-count events, not initial state.perish.count, for current count.
Preserve type-change, preparation and called-move event parameters.
Carry unknown/errors/repair and rejection information to diagnostics.
Do not union erroneous move histories or take maximum false use counts.
Check the installed WASM interface; source references alone are not proof.
notes: Only output/transport helpers are exempt from battle-state mapping.
No function is deleted from the pinned reference file.
main and parseBattle are mixed functions; their input validation is retained.
This inventory records scope, not successful migration or battle coverage.
Condition locations are source excerpts; multiline tests remain in the reference.
